components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main CTA. Lime background on dark surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: oklch(0.83 0.18 120); color: oklch(0.13 0.008 250); padding: 10px 24px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.75 0.16 120); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.83 0.18 120 / 0.4); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.93 0.005 240); padding: 10px 24px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid oklch(0.22 0.008 250); cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms, color 200ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: oklch(0.22 0.008 250); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.83 0.18 120 / 0.4); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Code Block
components.description: Pre-formatted code with card background and border.
components.css: .ds-code-block { background: oklch(0.16 0.008 250); border: 1px solid oklch(0.22 0.008 250); border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px; overflow-x: auto; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Fira Code', monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5; color: oklch(0.93 0.005 240); }

components.name: Inline Code
components.css: .ds-inline-code { padding: 2px 6px; font-size: 0.875em; background: oklch(0.18 0.008 250); border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; }

narrative.overview: A dark, cool-toned surface that reads like a well-configured terminal: calm authority, no visual noise, every element earning its place. The palette is anchored by cool blue-tinted neutrals (hue 250) and a single lime accent that appears sparingly, like a cursor blinking on a dark screen. This is infrastructure documentation, not a SaaS landing. The system explicitly rejects cream backgrounds, warm sand tones, gradient text, and the AI-generated marketing aesthetic.
keyCharacteristics: Lime accent used surgically, never decoratively
Flat depth model: borders and tonal shifts, not shadows
Inter + JetBrains Mono pairing: functional and readable
Border-based separation, not cards or elevation

rules.name: The Lime Restraint Rule
rules.body: The primary lime accent appears on no more than 10% of any given viewport. Its power comes from scarcity.

rules.name: The Cool Neutral Rule
rules.body: All surface and text colors use cool-tinted neutrals (hue 240-250). Never tint toward warm or beige.

rules.name: The Single Family Rule
rules.body: Inter handles all non-code text. No display serifs, no decorative fonts.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No element has a drop shadow at rest. Depth comes from border + background contrast.

dos: Do use lime sparingly. It is the only saturated color.
Do use cool-tinted neutrals for all surfaces and text.
Do separate elements with borders and tonal shifts, not shadows.
Do maintain 4.5:1 contrast for body text.
Do use Inter for all non-code text and JetBrains Mono for code.
donts: Don't use cream, sand, beige, or warm-tinted backgrounds.
Don't use glassmorphism, backdrop blurs, or decorative frosted glass.
Don't add drop shadows to cards, buttons, or containers at rest.
Don't use identical card grids repeated across sections.
Don't use marketing buzzwords in copy.
Don't use numbered section eyebrows unless the content is genuinely a sequence.
